edges.clause: Definition O2: positive cone closed under addition and multiplication. The existing finite-list induction applies this to nonnegative weighted conditional probabilities and indicators.
Definition: empty event has measure zero; pairwise disjoint countable unions have the nonnegative series mass. Padding/disjointifying gives the finite additivity/subadditivity already stated in F3.

Definition D: x(y+z)=xy+xz; M includes commutativity on all elements. This is the explicitly cited factorization law for the two finite sums in 1.2 and finite average expansions.
